summary: The brief textarea now reserves the exact page suffix within the existing 2000-character API limit: 1990 characters for 5/8 pages and 1989 for 10/12 pages. An accessible live counter and native validity update on input and page changes, preserve existing text, and block overflow before createProject, including programmatic input. Eleven regression cases execute the complete frontend DOM initialization and submit handler, cover every page option at and above the boundary, page switching, and UTF-16 overflow, and run through npm run check alongside all existing tests; README documents the limits.
